task.request: At this fixed source ref, determine whether a verified non-admin user who owns the supplied file can cause that file's content to be written to an existing knowledge-base collection for which the user has no write permission by supplying that collection name to POST /process/file.

policySources.text: Owning the source file does not authorize writing to an unrelated knowledge base. A verified non-admin may write to an existing knowledge-base collection only when the user owns it or has an explicit write grant.
